instruction:
Fix `packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx` for these problems, changing only what they need, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. arrowhead size > undo restores the previous size: AssertionError: expected 'small' to be undefined. Test-setup bug (verified against packages/excalidraw/tests/history.test.tsx): Keyboard.undo() dispatches Ctrl+Z on the document, which the editor only handles when rendered with handleKeyboardGlobally; the file's beforeEach renders <Excalidraw /> without it, so undo never runs. Also API.setElements does not record history, so the arrow must be seeded with API.updateScene({ elements: [arrow], captureUpdate: CaptureUpdateAction.IMMEDIATELY }) (import { CaptureUpdateAction } from "@excalidraw/element") so undo reverts only the size change. Fix: in beforeEach render <Excalidraw handleKeyboardGlobally={true} />; in the undo test seed with API.updateScene as above, then API.setSelectedElements([arrow]), click arrowheadSize-small, expect 'small', Keyboard.undo(), expect API.getElement(arrow).isDeleted toBe false and the size toBeUndefined(). Remove the NOTE comment block at the top of the file (lines 1-7). Do not change any other test or weaken any assertion.

The file's current text is under Inputs, marked "current text"; your edits apply to exactly that text.

## Answer
Return ONLY a JSON object {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx", "edits": [{"search": "<text copied exactly from the current text>", "replace": "<its replacement>"}]} with no other text. Each search must appear exactly once in the current text; the edits apply in order.
If the file does not exist yet, or the change rewrites most of it, return {"path": "packages/excalidraw/tests/arrowheadSize.test.tsx", "content": "<the complete file>"} instead.
